product.name: Indio by Monoprice Low Profile 6in Guitar Effects Pedal & Pedalboard Patch Cable 6-Pack
product.description: For modern players, guitar pedals are a given. However, with pedals (plural!) come a potential for cable‑related issues: repeated connections, noise, a tangled mess, etc. With their connector design and specs, Indio™ pedal patch cables are built to eliminate all problems associated with pedalboards. Packaged in both 3‑ and 6‑packs, Indio pedal patch cables are convenient for most common pedalboard configurations.At 6" in length and with a super low profile, right‑angle 1/4" TS connector design, Indio guitar pedal patch cables allow you to seamlessly incorporate new effects and expand your board. Additionally, Indio pedalboard cables are built with a thick PVC jacket that prevents faults, as well as 24AWG conductors for superior signal transfer.Features: 6" length1/4" TS low profile connectors24AWG wire gaugeMonoprice™, Indio™, the Indio logo, and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
